text:
Nadia: Quick async stitchpoint for the quarter milestone — please drop 1-2 line status: what shipped, what slipped, owner, next step. tagging folks who own pieces @Sam @Ravi @Lia @Andre.

Sam: Shipped: partial runtime V2 autoscale hook into dedicated pools. Canary ran for 6h with stable latencies. Owner: Sam. Next: push docs + expand canary to 10% tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

Ravi: Slipped: autoscale policy cleanup (dedicated) blocked by infra API change. Root cause: storage quota migration bumped SDK dep. Owner: Ravi + eng-infra. ETA: ~2w after infra patch. :warning:

Lia: CR pings: PR #1123 (autoscale policy) waiting on @Andre and @Sam for design + perf comments. I added small inline notes. Can we get reviews by EOD today?

Andre: I can review PR #1123 this afternoon. Also flag: rollout doc needs a fallback knob example (how to force single-model routing) — I'll add a short snippet.

Maya: Product note: customers on Dedicated care most about consistent tail latency. If autoscale ETA slides, we should surface temporary limits in release notes and update SLAs. Also need a short copy for console banner if we pause canaries.

Sam: Acknowledged — will add banner draft, +docs.

Nadia: Short unblock asks: (1) Ravi — can eng-infra prioritize the SDK patch? (2) Andre — can you prioritize PR review? (3) Lia — queue CR followups and mark any blocking comments with "BLOCK" prefix.

Ravi: Eng-infra triage scheduled for 11:00 PT. I put this at P0 for the sprint. If SDK patch lands, we can resume autoscale work next week.

Andre: Reviewing now. If I hit perf questions I'll call out in the PR with a perf test suggestion.

Lia: CR checklist: 1) correctness, 2) perf smoke, 3) doc example. I've added a template comment to streamline.

ci-bot: Build 4821 — integration — FAILED
```
FAIL tests.test_kv_cache::TestKVCache::test_prefix_eviction
E   AssertionError: expected cache_size 1024 but got 0
```

Sam: Noted — looks related to the SDK migration Ravi mentioned. I'm running the failing test locally now.

Ravi: I'll coordinate with ci infra if it's infra-level. Pinging @eng-infra channel.

Nadia: Quick wrap: owners and next steps list — please confirm inline.
- autoscale policy (dedicated): owner Ravi; status slipped; next: SDK patch -> resume (ETA 2w)
- runtime V2 hook (canary): owner Sam; status shipped partial; next: expand canary + docs + console banner (tomorrow)
- PR #1123 review: owner Andre; status pending review; next: review + perf comment (today)
- CR tracking: owner Lia; status in progress; next: tag BLOCK comments and followups

Sam: Confirmed.
Ravi: Confirmed.
Andre: Confirmed, will review today.
Lia: Confirmed, will follow up on any BLOCK items.
Maya: Thanks — I'll draft the customer communication and banner copy after docs update is pushed.

Nadia: Great — thanks all. If anything slips further, please update this thread (short update only). :thumbsup:
